recipes.name: Chicken & Spinach Frittata
steps: Heat an oven-safe pan and soften the onion with garlic.
Add chicken and spinach, cooking until the leaves wilt.
Whisk the eggs with half the cheddar, pour in, top with the rest and bake until set.

recipes.name: Garden Shakshuka
steps: Cook the onion and bell pepper until soft.
Simmer the tomatoes with cumin and paprika.
Fold in spinach, make wells, crack in the eggs and cook until the whites set.

recipes.name: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
steps: Saute the onion and garlic in butter.
Add broccoli and stock, simmering until tender.
Blend, then stir through milk and cheddar over low heat.

recipes.name: Creamy Chicken & Spinach Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta until al dente.
Sear the chicken with garlic, then wilt in the spinach.
Stir in milk and parmesan to make a sauce and toss with the pasta.

recipes.name: Chickpea Coconut Curry
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and ginger with curry powder.
Add tomato, chickpeas and coconut milk, then simmer until thick.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Scramble the eggs and set aside.
Stir-fry the chicken, carrot and bell pepper over high heat.
Add rice and soy sauce, fold the egg and spring onion back in.

recipes.name: Cheese Omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs with a splash of milk.
Pour into foaming butter and cook gently.
Scatter cheddar over one half and fold.

recipes.name: Black Bean Tacos
steps: Warm the black beans with cumin.
Char the corn tortillas.
Fill with beans, avocado, tomato and a squeeze of lime and cilantro.

recipes.name: Stuffed Peppers Caprese
steps: Halve and deseed the bell peppers.
Fill with rice, tomato and mozzarella.
Bake until soft and finish with fresh basil.

recipes.name: Broccoli Ginger Stir-fry
steps: Stir-fry the broccoli and carrot over high heat.
Add garlic, ginger and soy sauce.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Salmon & Veg Traybake
steps: Scatter zucchini, tomato and bell pepper on a tray with olive oil.
Nestle the salmon on top and squeeze over lemon.
Roast until the salmon flakes.

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
steps: Melt the butter and soften the garlic.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink.
Finish with lemon and spring onion.

recipes.name: Banana Oat Pancakes
steps: Blend the banana, oats, egg and milk into a batter.
Ladle into a hot non-stick pan.
Flip when bubbles form and cook through.

recipes.name: Overnight Oats with Walnuts
steps: Stir the oats into the milk with a drizzle of honey.
Chill overnight.
Top with banana and walnuts before eating.

recipes.name: Minestrone Soup
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and garlic.
Add tomato, chickpeas, stock and pasta.
Simmer until the pasta is tender, then stir in spinach.

recipes.name: Mushroom Spinach Quesadilla
steps: Saute the mushrooms until golden and wilt in the spinach.
Fill a tortilla with the mix and cheddar.
Toast in a dry pan until crisp and the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Beef Tacos
steps: Brown the beef with onion, cumin and paprika.
Warm the corn tortillas.
Fill with beef and top with tomato, cheddar, cilantro and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Brown the beef with onion and garlic.
Add tomato and simmer into a rich sauce.
Toss with cooked pasta and finish with parmesan.

recipes.name: Tortilla Margherita Flatbread
steps: Top the tortillas with tomato and mozzarella.
Bake or pan-toast until the cheese melts.
Scatter with fresh basil.

recipes.name: Greek Salad
steps: Chop the cucumber, tomato and onion.
Toss with olives and feta.
Dress with olive oil.

recipes.name: Red Lentil Soup
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and carrot.
Add lentils, cumin and stock, then simmer until tender.
Blend partially for a creamy texture.

recipes.name: Beef & Broccoli Stir-fry
steps: Sear the beef over high heat and set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli with garlic and ginger.
Return the beef, toss with soy sauce and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Pork Chops with Apples
steps: Sear the pork chops in butter until golden.
Add sliced onion and apple to the pan.
Cook until the apples soften and the pork is cooked through.

recipes.name: BLT Sandwich
steps: Fry the bacon until crisp.
Toast the bread and spread with mayo.
Layer with lettuce, tomato and bacon.

recipes.name: Tuna Salad Sandwich
steps: Mix the tuna with mayo and spring onion.
Season with a squeeze of lemon.
Pile onto bread and slice.

recipes.name: Turkey Chili
steps: Brown the turkey with onion.
Stir in tomato, black beans, cumin and paprika.
Simmer until thickened.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Honey Parfait
steps: Spoon the yogurt into bowls.
Drizzle with honey.
Top with banana and walnuts.

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
steps: Slice the tomato and mozzarella.
Arrange alternating slices on a plate.
Scatter with basil and drizzle with olive oil.

recipes.name: Eggplant Parmesan
steps: Slice the eggplant, dust with flour and pan-fry until golden.
Layer with tomato, mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake until bubbling.

recipes.name: Cauliflower Fried Rice
steps: Pulse the cauliflower into rice-sized pieces.
Scramble the egg and set aside.
Stir-fry the cauliflower with carrot, garlic and soy sauce, then fold the egg and spring onion back in.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Black Bean Bowl
steps: Roast the sweet potato with cumin until tender.
Warm the black beans.
Assemble in a bowl with avocado, lime and cilantro.

recipes.name: Kale Caesar Salad
steps: Massage the kale with olive oil and lemon.
Toast bread cubes for croutons.
Toss with parmesan and croutons.

recipes.name: Tofu Vegetable Stir-fry
steps: Pan-fry the tofu until golden and set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli and carrot with garlic and ginger.
Return the tofu, toss with soy sauce and a drizzle of sesame oil.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
steps: Add the banana, peanut butter, milk and oats to a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Sweeten with honey if needed.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Quinoa Bowl
steps: Cook the quinoa and let it cool slightly.
Toss with chickpeas, cucumber and tomato.
Finish with olives and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.name: Creamy Mushroom Soup
steps: Saute the mushroom, onion and garlic in butter.
Add stock and simmer, then blend until smooth.
Stir in milk and warm through.

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
steps: Sear the chicken and slice.
Fill the tortillas with lettuce, chicken and parmesan.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon and roll up.

recipes.name: Salmon Poke Bowl
steps: Cube the salmon and marinate briefly in soy sauce and sesame oil.
Cook the rice and let it cool slightly.
Assemble the bowl with rice, salmon, cucumber, avocado and spring onion.

recipes.name: Shrimp Tacos with Cabbage Slaw
steps: Season and cook the shrimp until pink.
Toss the cabbage with lime and cilantro for a quick slaw.
Warm the tortillas and fill with shrimp and slaw.

recipes.name: Cauliflower Chickpea Curry
steps: Fry the onion, garlic and ginger with curry powder.
Add cauliflower, chickpeas, tomato and coconut milk.
Simmer until the cauliflower is tender.

recipes.name: Baked Ziti
steps: Cook the pasta until just al dente.
Toss with tomato and half the mozzarella and parmesan.
Top with remaining cheese and bake until bubbling.

recipes.name: Cinnamon French Toast
steps: Whisk the egg with milk and cinnamon.
Dip the bread slices and fry in butter until golden.
Serve with a drizzle of honey.

recipes.name: Fluffy Pancakes
steps: Whisk the flour, egg and milk into a smooth batter.
Ladle onto a hot buttered pan.
Flip when bubbles form and cook through.

recipes.name: Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Simmer the chicken with carrot, onion and garlic in stock.
Shred the chicken once cooked through.
Add pasta and cook until tender.

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Mushrooms
steps: Melt the butter in a hot pan.
Add the mushrooms and garlic, and cook until golden.
Season and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado and spread it on top.
Squeeze over lemon juice and season to taste.

recipes.name: Honey Yogurt Bowl
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
Drizzle with honey.
Top with walnuts if using.

recipes.name: Cheese Quesadilla
steps: Scatter cheddar over half a tortilla and fold.
Cook in a dry pan until golden on both sides and the cheese melts.
Slice and serve, topped with spring onion if using.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with peanut butter.
Top with sliced banana.

recipes.name: Garlic Broccoli Saute
steps: Heat the olive oil and garlic in a pan.
Add the broccoli and stir-fry until just tender.
Season and serve.

recipes.name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp
steps: Saute the garlic in butter until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.name: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Scramble the egg in a hot wok and set aside.
Stir-fry the rice, then return the egg to the pan.
Add soy sauce and toss to coat.

recipes.name: Bacon and Eggs
steps: Fry the bacon until crisp.
Crack the eggs into the same pan and cook to taste.

recipes.name: Apple Cinnamon Oats
steps: Simmer the oats with the diced apple and cinnamon until creamy.
Drizzle with honey if using.

recipes.name: Tomato Cucumber Salad
steps: Chop the tomato and cucumber.
Toss with olive oil and season.
Crumble feta over the top if using.

recipes.name: Tuna Melt
steps: Top the bread with tuna and cheddar.
Grill or broil until the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Buttered Cinnamon Sweet Potato
steps: Roast or microwave the sweet potato until tender.
Split open and mash with butter and cinnamon.

recipes.name: Simple Tofu Stir-fry
steps: Pan-fry the tofu until golden on all sides.
Toss with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Garnish with spring onion if using.

recipes.name: Caprese Bites
steps: Slice the mozzarella and tomato.
Layer with basil leaves.
Drizzle with olive oil if using.

recipes.name: Buttered Rice
steps: Cook the rice until tender.
Stir in butter and season to taste.

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Pasta
steps: Boil the pasta until al dente.
Melt butter with garlic in a pan.
Toss the pasta through the garlic butter.

recipes.name: Cheese Toast
steps: Top the bread with cheddar.
Grill or toast until the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Simple Tomato Salad
steps: Slice the tomatoes.
Drizzle with olive oil and season.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread generously with peanut butter.

recipes.name: Banana Oat Bites
steps: Mash the banana and mix with oats.
Spoon into bites and bake or pan-fry until golden.

recipes.name: Garlic Sauteed Spinach
steps: Melt butter if using and add garlic.
Add spinach and wilt down.
Season and serve.

recipes.name: Buttered Tortillas
steps: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Brush with butter and serve.

recipes.name: Cucumber Yogurt Dip
steps: Grate the cucumber and squeeze out excess water.
Stir into the yogurt and season.

recipes.name: Honey Banana Oatmeal
steps: Cook the oats with water or milk.
Mash in the banana.
Drizzle with honey to serve.

recipes.name: Lemon Butter Salmon
steps: Pan-sear the salmon in butter.
Squeeze over lemon juice.
Serve immediately.

recipes.name: Soy Ginger Tofu
steps: Pan-fry the tofu until golden.
Add ginger and soy sauce.
Toss to coat and serve.

recipes.name: Garlic Parmesan Broccoli
steps: Steam or roast the broccoli.
Toss with garlic and grated parmesan.

recipes.name: Buttered Peas
steps: Cook the peas until tender.
Toss with butter and season.

recipes.name: Buttered Carrots
steps: Steam or boil the carrots until tender.
Toss with butter and season.

recipes.name: Cheesy Scrambled Eggs
steps: Whisk the eggs.
Scramble in butter if using.
Fold in cheddar until melted.

recipes.name: Tuna Mayo Sandwich
steps: Mix the tuna with mayo.
Spread onto the bread and serve.

recipes.name: Lemon Kale Salad
steps: Massage the kale with olive oil and lemon juice.
Season and serve.

recipes.name: Simple Cabbage Slaw
steps: Shred the cabbage.
Toss with mayo and a squeeze of lime if using.

recipes.name: Turkey Lettuce Wraps
steps: Cook the turkey through.
Spoon into lettuce leaves with mayo if using and wrap.

recipes.name: Chickpea Lemon Salad
steps: Toss the chickpeas with lemon juice and olive oil.
Season and serve.

recipes.name: Black Beans and Rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Warm the black beans and stir through.

recipes.name: Sesame Cucumber Salad
steps: Slice the cucumber.
Toss with sesame oil and soy sauce if using.

recipes.name: Apple Peanut Butter Snack
steps: Slice the apple.
Serve with peanut butter for dipping.

recipes.name: Caramelized Onions
steps: Slice the onions thinly.
Cook slowly in butter until deeply golden and sweet.

recipes.name: Simple Chicken and Rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Season and cook the chicken through.
Serve the chicken over the rice, with onion if using.

recipes.name: Warm Honey Milk
steps: Warm the milk gently.
Stir in honey to taste.

recipes.name: Roasted Bell Peppers
steps: Toss the peppers with olive oil.
Roast until charred and soft, with garlic if using.

recipes.name: Garlic Zucchini Saute
steps: Slice the zucchini.
Saute with garlic in olive oil until tender.

recipes.name: Buttery Cauliflower Mash
steps: Boil the cauliflower until very tender.
Mash with butter until smooth, adding milk if using.

recipes.name: Simple Lentil Soup
steps: Simmer the lentils in vegetable stock until tender.
Add onion if using for extra flavor.

recipes.name: Lemon Olive Oil Quinoa
steps: Cook the quinoa until fluffy.
Toss with lemon juice and olive oil.

recipes.name: Curried Coconut Chickpeas
steps: Simmer the chickpeas in coconut milk with curry powder until warmed through.

recipes.name: Cumin Roasted Carrots
steps: Toss the carrots with olive oil and cumin.
Roast until caramelized.

recipes.name: Paprika Sweet Potato Wedges
steps: Cut the sweet potato into wedges and toss with olive oil and paprika.
Roast until crisp.

recipes.name: Olive Tomato Salad
steps: Toss the tomato and olives together.
Crumble feta over the top if using.

recipes.name: Cilantro Lime Rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Fluff with lime juice and chopped cilantro.
